title: armeria bourgaei var. dasyphylla
intro: Armeria bourgaei var. dasyphylla, commonly known as Dasyphyllum Armeria, is a plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. It is a type of flowering plant known for its medicinal properties. The plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
